delivery_contract.scope: cumulative changed/new MathIllustrator files since Cut00 + website root index.html/tools.html (required integration exception)

data_contract.name: mathillustrator-project
data_contract.migration_policy: Additive v1 rectangle object, legacy polygon-based rectangles preserved; older v1 JSON settings defaults unchanged. Cut08 safety tightening: older v1 projects with snapStep below 1e-6 must be explicitly corrected before import (no hidden migration).

browser_smoke: 100/100 Node; 27/27 isolated Chromium editor suites (including new storage recovery), three emulated phone sizes inherited. Real physical touch and tab atomicity unverified.
quality_rules: never hide fallback
document limitations precisely
test transitive and second-order behavior
update tutorial and documentation on every cut
do not modify MathReader
no silent remote computation
disabled output buttons for unsupported formats/scenes
record test provenance; isolated browser is not a hosted-site verification
preserve old JSON compatibility
quarantine malformed localStorage until explicit user resolution
editor guides never leak into exports by default
subtle negative-path matrix from MathReader regression discipline
reject unsafe tikz-cd if semantic graph differs after exact parser round-trip
guard detached UI closures against reused IDs by document-instance identity
pointer-up endpoints authoritative, but click-only selection cannot snap
zero-opacity label and hit-target parity
marker-free arrow geometry avoids SVG global ID collisions
virtualized object rows preserve full search/scroll and state identity
point hit testing is geometric and respects visibility and opacity
offscreen culling is display-only and must not corrupt project JSON
plan existing-anchor reuse atomically before appending new reference points
opacity-zero points remain semantic dependencies but are not automatic snap targets
visible-only export capability checks and view-zoom-independent TikZ styling
exclusive Web Locks only for normal saves where supported; unloaded and legacy fallbacks not atomic
Cumulative overlay must include every prior cut original path, including original Cut00 examples and architecture decision
live rectangles have exactly two point-like anchor refs; legacy polygon rectangles are unchanged
reject async native-file completion when the document has since been modified
do not rerender focused property controls during adjacent valid edits
never truncate prompted labels; do not enable pdfLaTeX TikZ for unsupported visible Unicode/control labels
all feature controls enumerated in cut07-control-matrix.json with precise verification provenance
Reject new geometry collapse on anchor move while permitting imported legacy degeneracies
All XML/SVG text remains valid Unicode XML 1.0; never silently normalize invalid characters
Snap precision limits align across runtime, schema, UI and tutorial
Large object-list search uses indexed ID/name lookups
Include latest separately issued tools.html homepage integration in cumulative ZIP
diagram morphism arrows are clipped to node boxes; model refs never changed by view-only layout
limit function SVG path cache and invalidate on camera/expression changes
infinite lines clipped for display, not for document data
modal export backdrop and keyboard focus must agree
visibilitychange belongs to document, not window; rollback unfinished Move and Pan on tab hide
Fit must ignore fully transparent objects and morphisms whose nodes are invisible
Batch anchor snapping reuses pre-gesture spatial index with strict 12px cutoff and deterministic first-created tie order
New drawing default changes cannot retroactively restyle legacy v1 point objects without explicit pinning of prior appearance
Destructive keyboard shortcuts require a drawing/object-list context; never fire on focused unrelated toolbar controls
Export-only UI settings are document undo/autosave state but must not synchronously rebuild the visible SVG
Preset indicators must account for all drawing defaults owned by the preset, without overriding unrelated export/page/theme settings
Incomplete multi-click constructions are ephemeral and must not cross document replacement or tab-hidden transitions
Every delayed native file import must check both edit revision and project-generation identity before application
IME composition must not invoke destructive canvas or modal Escape shortcuts
Changing viewport geometry during a pointer drag must cancel that incomplete gesture before transforming cursor coordinates
Do not classify a simulated storage quota test as proof of browser-origin quota or multi-tab atomicity
Touch construction waits for confirmed single-contact release, unlike mouse and pen controls
Secondary touches outside the canvas must also abort active touch constructions
Coarse pointer emulation does not certify real physical touchscreen behavior
Mobile Export and Save controls must remain visible without page overflow at 320px or wider
Synthetic storage Web Locks tests do not certify simultaneous-tab atomicity
